plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: "LLM agent" AND (architecture OR "system design" OR framework)
queries.rationale: Catches papers describing novel agent system designs and structural components, directly relevant to engineering.

queries.query: "language model agent" AND ("memory" OR "long-term context" OR "knowledge retention")
queries.rationale: Targets research on persistent memory mechanisms, a key practical challenge for building capable agents.

queries.query: "autonomous agent" AND ("LLM" OR "large language model") AND (tool OR "API integration" OR "external call")
queries.rationale: Focuses on agents interacting with external tools/APIs, a core engineering task for real-world functionality.
Captures work on systems of interacting agents, an important scaling direction for complex applications.
Targets techniques for breaking down complex goals into executable steps, a fundamental agent capability.

queries.query: "agent" AND ("reinforcement learning" OR RLHF OR "reward model") AND ("LLM" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Catches research on training/finetuning agents via reinforcement learning, a practical performance improvement path.

queries.query: "LLM agent" AND (evaluation OR benchmark OR "SWE-bench" OR "AgentBench")
queries.rationale: Focuses on how agent capabilities are measured, providing grounding on what 'improvements' actually mean.

queries.query: "LLM agent" AND ("code generation" OR "software repair" OR "automated debugging")
queries.rationale: Targets agents applied to coding tasks, aligning with the reader's software engineering background and interests.
Captures agents enhanced with retrieval-augmented generation, a common pattern for grounding agent responses.

queries.query: "agent" AND (hallucination OR "factual consistency" OR "verification") AND ("LLM" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets research on improving agent truthfulness/verification, a key practical concern for deployment.

queries.query: "LLM agent" AND ("cost" OR latency OR "resource efficiency")
queries.rationale: Focuses on the operational economics of running agents, crucial for anyone building real-world systems.

queries.query: "language model agent" AND ("human-in-the-loop" OR "user feedback" OR "interactive")
queries.rationale: Captures designs where agents work with human guidance, a relevant pattern for many practical applications.

queries.query: "LLM" AND "agent" AND ("embodied" OR robotics OR "physical world")
queries.rationale: Targets agents controlling physical systems, a distinct and growing application area with different engineering challenges.
Catches work focused on releasing reproducible agent systems or frameworks, valuable for an engineer building with them.

queries.query: "agent" AND ("self-improvement" OR "meta-learning" OR "reflection") AND ("LLM" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets agents that learn from their own experience, an advanced technique for creating more adaptive systems.

plan.coverage_notes: The plan covers core architectures, key techniques (memory, planning, RL, retrieval), evaluation, practical concerns (cost, tools, human interaction), and subspecialties aligned with software engineering and robotics. It deliberately avoids pure theoretical cognitive science or neuroscience angles, and avoids named proprietary products as standalone queries, per the profile's engineering-grounded preference.
